scope.exclusions: Awoken, Exo and Frame work is separately disclosed; Guardian resurrection is not ordinary universal provision.

after.description:
The Last City combines protection and science with supply crises and ordinary useful work. Frames provide civil, maintenance, vendor and defensive services, supplying actual labor substitution rather than only a powerful military backdrop. The guarantee best guess is weak because technical capacity does not ensure dependable equal food, housing or care under a threatened resource order. Guardian resurrection is not a general civilian necessities policy.

Human and human-derived institutions retain central authority, with intelligent systems assisting rather than automatically owning the city. The modest nonworking scenario counts science, supply, care, services and useful civic activity. Ordinary non-sentient Frames are equipment in the reference, while active Exos are persons; neither category becomes an extra biological human. The broad interval preserves unshown household detail. This zero variant concerns the recurring City rather than every siege or evacuation, and the Golden Age’s prosperity is not copied into the post-Collapse floor.

after.description:
The Vex continuously convert worlds into machinery through a cyber-organic collective. This is real production, but artificial-looking bodies do not establish a human welfare population or prove that every component is an individual person. The support best guess concerns autonomous mind identities within the sustaining network, with a very broad guarantee interval because internal resource rights are not described. It does not label the collective’s continuous activity as leisure.

The central control analogy stays near concentrated collective-person authority because cyber-organic computation is not automatically an unrelated AI sovereign. Stronger machine-style autonomy remains possible within the wide interval. The central nonworking scenario is zero because active minds perform ongoing transformation, coordination and simulation roles. Cells, processing threads and ordinary chassis are not multiplied into residents. This zero-variant comparison is explicitly nonliteral for human employment and preserves uncertainty about person boundaries rather than claiming a census from the scale of the machinery.

after.description:
Clovis Bray experiments on humans, develops Exo bodies and uses memory manipulation to sustain the project. Technical continuation therefore coexists with exploitation and actual research or service work. The guarantee best guess is very weak because access to bodies and care is controlled by the institution rather than secure for every participant. Engineering a new body is not the same as giving its active mind an unconditional right to continue.

Human and human-derived creator authority is central, rather than automatically external AI because a ruler or subject can be copied. The low nonworking scenario counts assigned research, technical duties, care and useful service among active persons. Memory erasure does not make an individual a new leisure citizen, and inactive bodies are excluded. The broad interval preserves variation between subjects and staff. This zero variant concerns the actual development order, not the material rights of later independent Exos or the whole Golden Age human population.

after.description:
Companions inherit an empty human city and develop a society of their own, with real services, trade and maintenance. Their sustaining infrastructure is technological, but robotic existence does not make energy, parts or security unlimited. The guarantee best guess is conditional and comparatively weak because class divisions, restrictions and inherited systems remain important. Absent humans are not described as enjoying complete leisure.

The active artificial society operates without living human owners, placing external control toward autonomous machine authority. Internal hierarchy and city-control protocols remain distinct from equal ownership among residents. The modest nonworking scenario counts repair, services, care-like work, trade and useful cultural roles. B-12 is a separate human-derived case, and the visiting cat does not alter the person count. Wide intervals preserve ordinary allocation detail. Opening the city changes opportunities, but does not establish an already documented universal material constitution or erase the real work done by Companions.

The later plague is not used as the only reason for that estimate, nor as a measure of how many people stopped working.
